    return column_name

    version_match = re.search(r'v(\d+)\.(\d+)', policy_text)
    if version_match:

        return (major, minor)
    return (0, 0)

        r'date.*?(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})',
        r'(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})'
    ]
    for pattern in date_patterns:
        match = re.search(pattern, policy_text.lower())
        if match:
            return match.group(1)
    return None
